streamDefinition: At least 16 consecutive authored rows, gaps at most half a beat and 200 ms. A density proxy, not annotated instrument solos.

measurement.selection: Maximum macro whole-song F1 at 40 ms on the four development songs, chosen from eight fixed configurations.
limitations: Authored-chart agreement, not instrument-level transcription or a ChartNet comparison.
Stream ranges are a density proxy, not manually annotated solos.
Original Return of Salieri MP3 emits an FFmpeg invalid-packet warning; decode exits zero and chart rows fit the resulting duration.
Browser audio decoding/resampling can differ slightly from the FFmpeg benchmark.
